item.title: Google On When To Fix 404 Errors & Updates 404 & Sitemaps Docs
item.content:encoded:
Google；搜索抓取错误；站点地图；404错误；Search Console

总结:1. Google更新了两篇帮助文档；2. 一篇涉及Google搜索抓取错误排查；3. 一篇解释什么是站点地图；4. 最大变化是说明是否应在Search Console中修复404错误；5. 两篇文档还有其他变化值得关注。
Google just pushed an update to its troubleshooting Google Search crawling errors help document and the what is a sitemap help document. The biggest change is that Google explains whether to fix 404 errors in Search Console or not. But there are other changes in these documents that you should be aware of.

总结: 1. 本周，Google 2026年11月核心更新已完成。2. 随后，Google意外预先宣布2026年12月核心更新，但该更新目前尚未上线。3. Google还推出了新的搜索排名中心。
This week, we covered the completion of the Google November 2026 core update and then were hit by a surprise, preannounced Google December 2026 core update; no, it is not live yet. Google launched a new search ranking hub....

item.title: Bing AI Mode Ads Blending More With Organic Results
item.content:encoded:
微软广告；Bing AI模式；广告辨识；自然结果；Copilot搜索

总结:
1. 微软广告使Bing AI模式结果中的广告与自然结果更难区分。
2. 微软长期在搜索结果中让用户难以判断广告与自然列表。
3. 因此可预期其在AI模式和Copilot搜索中继续如此。
Microsoft Advertising is making it harder to distinguish ads in Bing AI Mode results from organic results. Microsoft has a very long history of making it hard to understand what is an advertisement versus what is an organic listing in its search results, so you can expect them to continue to do this within AI Mode and Copilot Search.

item.title: Google AI Mode Image Results Ask A Follow Up Button
item.content:encoded:
Google AI Mode、图片搜索结果、追问、右侧图片面板、按钮变体

总结:
1. Google AI Mode 现在支持用户对图片搜索结果提出追问；
2. 操作方式：用户先点击图片，并在右侧的图片面板中查看该图片；
3. 该功能有两种呈现形式；
4. 其一是“Ask a follow-up”，该按钮外围带有动画效果的 Google 光环；
5. 其二是“Ask about this image”按钮。
Google AI Mode now lets you Ask a follow up question on image results, after you click on the image and see the image on the right side image pane. I see two variations of this, including "Ask a follow-up" that has an animated Google ring around the button and a "Ask about this image" button.

item.title: Google AI Mode Gains Multiple Image Uploads
item.content:encoded:
谷歌AI模式、多图上传、拍照、单次查询、最多10张

总结:1. Google AI Mode新增功能，支持在一次查询中拍摄多张照片或上传多张图片；2. 该功能类似此前的图像集合AI模式功能；3. 一次查询最多可附加10张图片；4. Google会综合所有图片内容进行回答。
Google AI Mode now lets you snap multiple photos or upload multiple images for one query. Similar to what we saw with the image collections AI Mode feature, you can now attach up to 10 images to an AI Mode query and Google will respond taking into consideration all the images.

item.title: Google Ads Search Insights Tool
item.content:encoded:
Google Ads、搜索广告洞察、新兴趋势、衰退趋势、首次覆盖

总结: 1. Google Ads 提供搜索广告洞察工具（search insights）。2. 它展示与主题或品类相关的新兴和衰退趋势。3. 该工具并不算很新，近期能找到相关 Google Ads 文档和博客文章。4. 作者此前从未覆盖过它。
Google Ads has a search ads insights tool, also known as search insights, that shows you emerging and declining trends related to your topic or category. I don't think this is super new, as I found some Google Ads documents and blog posts on it recently but I have never covered it before.

item.title: Google Merchant Center Ads Opportunities With New Features?
item.content:encoded:
Google Merchant Center、Ads opportunities、代理商、new标签、广告商

总结: 1. Google Merchant Center可能正面向代理商推广“Ads opportunities”功能；2. 该功能此前已被报道过两次；3. 目前部分广告商在控制台的“Ads opportunities”板块看到“new”标签，显示其可能正在上线或推广。
Google Merchant Center may be rolling out the Ads opportunities feature in Google Merchant Center for Agencies, which we covered twice already. Now, some advertisers are seeing the "new" label on the "Ads opportunities" section in the console.

item.title: Copilot Has Ads From Microsoft Advertising
item.content:encoded:
微软、Copilot、广告、Microsoft Advertising、部分用户

总结:1. 微软正在Copilot回复中向部分用户展示广告；2. 广告由Microsoft Advertising提供；3. 这并非新现象，今年早些时候已有案例；4. 这是作者首次报道此事。
Microsoft is showing ads in Copilot responses to some users powered by Microsoft Advertising. I don't think this is new, I see some examples of this from earlier this year, but this is the first time I am covering it.

item.title: Ask Jeeves At Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade (Old Photos)
item.content:encoded:
梅西感恩节大游行、首次因天气推迟、Danny Sullivan、Ask Jeeves、三次参加

总结: 1. 感恩节纽约通常举行梅西感恩节大游行。2. 今天该游行首次因天气原因推迟。3. Danny Sullivan提醒，早期搜索引擎Ask Jeeves持续近30年。4. Ask Jeeves曾三次参加该游行。
On Thanksgiving day we normally have the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York City but today, for the first time, it was postponed due to weather. And Danny Sullivan reminded me that Ask Jeeves, which was an early search engine and lasted nearly 30 years, that Ask Jeeves was at the parade three times.

item.title: Google Local Pack No Reviews Bug
item.content:encoded:
Google本地包；评论不显示；No reviews；无星级；点击可见

总结:1. 部分商家确实有评论，但Google本地包不展示其评论；2. 这些商家在本地包中显示“No reviews”，且没有星级；3. 点击进入该商家列表页后，Google又能显示其评论。
Google is not showing reviews in the local pack for some business listings that do indeed have reviews. Google shows "No reviews" with no stars in the local pack for these businesses, but when you click on the listing, Google does show that these businesses have reviews.

item.content:encoded:

总结: 1. 微软似乎在测试Bing搜索结果中鼠标悬停图片时的新按钮。2. 此前视觉搜索按钮点击后会进入新界面。3. 现在Ask按钮可让用户为该图片搜索补充查询上下文。

Google Images，收藏集，Ask anything，AI Mode，保存图片

The Google Images collections & saved items section added an "Ask anything" button, where it will take all the images in the collection and let you ask Google AI Mode about them in one shot. Yes, Google is even sticking AI Mode into the images you save to your collections in Google Image Search.

item.title: Google On How Links Are Selected & Shown In AI Overviews & AI Mode
item.content:encoded:
<｜end▁of▁thinking｜>关键词：Google、Search generative AI、Attribution、factuality、links

总结: 1. Google 发布了新文档《Attribution and factuality in Search generative AI features》，详细说明 AI Mode、AI Overviews 等生成式搜索功能如何选择展示的链接。 2. 该文档内容信息量很大，是更新后的文档与 Google Search 排名中心的一部分。 3. 核心关注点是生成式 AI 功能中的归因（attribution）与事实性（factuality）。 4. 文档解释了 Google 在这些功能中挑选并展示来源链接的机制。 5. 对希望了解 AI 搜索引用与来源展示规则的读者具有参考价值。
As part of the updated documentation and Google Search ranking hub we covered a new document named Attribution and factuality in Search generative AI features. This document is chock-full of information on how Google selects which links to show in AI Mode, AI Overviews and other Search generative AI features.

item.title: New Google Search Ranking Hub, Ranking Principles, Feedback & AI Training Control
item.content:encoded: Google has launched a new Google Search ranking hub that acts as a unified Search ranking transparency hub on Search Central. The hub features consolidated information about Google's ranking systems, notice timelines, status dashboard updates, and structured feedback pathways in one central location.

item.title: Google December 2026 Core Update Preannounced - Complex Queries & Personalization
item.content:encoded: Google has preannounced the December 2026 core update, which is new for Google. The December 2026 core update is not live yet, but it will be live sometime in December. Google said this update "focuses on multiple improvements to how our systems understand and rank relevant content (including for longer and more complex questions), as well as improving personalized results for people who have personalization turned."

item.title: Bing AI Generated Answer - Different From AI Overviews/Copilot Search
item.content:encoded: Microsoft Bing is testing a new flavor of AI-generated answers that are labeled "AI-Generated answer" and seem to be different from the Bing AI Overviews and Copilot Search boxes.
